### Summary
Upgraded `pydantic` from 1.10.4 to 2.14.0 across all manifest files (`requirements-dev.txt`, `requirements.txt`, `pyproject.toml`). The migration applied 13 transformation rules (R327, R344, R46, R6, R8, etc.) to replace v1 patterns with v2 equivalents. While 39/95 baseline tests pass, 56 tests fail, primarily in `tests.test_base` related to `BaseClass`, `BaseTool`, and `BaseToolExtended` creation and manipulation.

### Changes

| File | Change | Source Rule |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `bgameb/base.py` | `Base` class: Replaced `_counter`/`_logger` private fields with public `counter`/`logger`; replaced custom `__init__` with `@root_validator`/ `__pydantic_init__` pattern; added `model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True)`. | R327, R46 |
| `bgameb/base.py` | `PropertyBaseModel.dict()` → `model_dump()`; `super().dict()` → `super().model_dump()`. | R6 |
| `bgameb/base.py` | `BaseToolExtended` and `BaseTool` class definitions: Removed `GenericModel` from inheritance; updated method bodies to use `model_dump()`. | R344, R6 |
| `bgameb/base.py` | `BaseTool.model_dump_json()` → `model_dump_json()`. | R8 |
| `bgameb/items.py` | `Sides`: Replaced `ConstrainedInt` subclass with `Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)]`. | R46 |
| `bgameb/items.py` | `Step`, `Dice`, `Card`: Replaced `PositiveInt`/`NonNegativeInt`/`ConstrainedInt` with `Annotated[..., Field(...)]`. Updated `__eq__`/`__ne__` to use `model_dump()`. | R46 |
| `bgameb/items.py` | `Dice.roll()`: Updated to use `self.range_` instead of `self._range`. | R46 |
| `bgameb/tools.py` | `Shaker` class: Simplified inheritance from `BaseToolExtended`. | R344 |
| `requirements-dev.txt` / `requirements.txt` | Pinned: `pydantic==1.10.4` → `pydantic>=2,<3`. | — |
